diagnosis: QA setup was often serialized after production even when objective, acceptance criteria and source owner already made part of the checks preparable.
intervention: Added a reusable deterministic QA precompile contract/pass that classifies checks as PREPARED_NOW, WAITS_FOR_ARTIFACT, WAITS_FOR_SERVED_RUNTIME or HUMAN_ONLY; every check carries input, expected, evidence, failure disposition, blocking scope, owner and consumer. Added parallel producer/QA fixtures and CI regression.
tests: PASS producer remains IMPLEMENTING while contract QA is PREPARED_NOW
PASS artifact check waits only for artifact
PASS served browser check waits for served runtime
PASS subjective visual check is HUMAN_ONLY
PASS reversible candidate async QA does not infer global PRE_USABLE block
truth_boundary: QA preparation is derived evidence design, not acceptance/release/promotion authority; existing verifier/judge/integrator and promotion owners remain unchanged.
